steps: Identify pipes in unheated areas: crawlspace, garage, exterior walls.
Measure pipe diameter and buy matching foam pipe insulation sleeves.
Slide sleeves over straight runs; use tape at seams and joints.
Use pre-formed elbow pieces or extra tape at bends.
Focus first on any pipe that has frozen before.

materials.name: Frost King self-sealing foam pipe insulation
Cable Matters 100-pack nylon cable ties (4 / 8 / 12 in. assortment)
